description: Authenticates a domain for sending email through K2Mailer: DKIM signing key, SPF include, a DMARC policy (only when the domain has none) and a CNAME for open/click tracking links.
variableDescription: %dkimselector%: DKIM selector, e.g. 'k2mailer'. %dkimkey%: base64 RSA public key. %spfrules%: SPF mechanisms merged into the domain's SPF record, e.g. 'ip4:203.0.113.10'. %dmarcuser%: local part of the DMARC report address at the domain, e.g. 'dmarc'.
